items.question: Does the camera viewpoint remain stable and consistent with a nearby observer, without abrupt pans, jumps, or scene changes, as the operator transfers the scalpel and scrapes the plant root?
items.question_zh: 在操作者递解剖刀并刮擦植物根的过程中，摄像机视角是否保持稳定，且与附近观察者的视角一致，没有突然的平移、跳动或场景切换？

items.question: Does the scalpel remain a single, identifiable tool throughout the video, without duplicating, merging with the plant root, or morphing into another object?
items.question_zh: 在整个视频中，解剖刀是否始终是一个独立的、可辨识的工具，没有出现复制、与植物根融合或变成其他物体？

items.question: Does the plant root segment remain a single, identifiable object throughout the video, without splitting into multiple pieces, disappearing, or merging with the scalpel or the operator's hand?
items.question_zh: 在整个视频中，植物根段是否始终是一个独立的、可辨识的物体，没有裂成多段、消失，或与解剖刀或操作者的手融合？

items.question: Does the operator visibly transfer the scalpel from their right hand to their left hand at the start of the procedure?
items.question_zh: 在操作开始时，操作者是否明显地将解剖刀从右手递到左手？

items.question: Does the operator's left hand use the scalpel to scrape along the plant root?
items.question_zh: 操作者的左手是否用解剖刀沿着植物根刮擦？

items.question: Does the scalpel transfer from the right hand to the left hand occur before the left hand begins scraping the root?
items.question_zh: 解剖刀从右手递到左手是否发生在左手开始刮擦根之前？

items.question: Does the scraping action produce a visible peeling of light-colored inner bark from the plant root?
items.question_zh: 刮擦动作是否使植物根上可见地剥落出浅色的内层皮？

items.question: Does the scalpel maintain plausible contact with the root surface during scraping, without visibly penetrating or passing through the root?
items.question_zh: 在刮擦过程中，解剖刀是否与根表面保持合理的接触，没有明显刺入或穿透根？

items.question: Does the plant root remain held in the operator's right hand throughout the scraping, without floating or passing through the hand?
items.question_zh: 在整个刮擦过程中，植物根是否始终被握在操作者的右手里，没有漂浮或穿过手？

items.question: Does the operator avoid accidental cuts or contact of the scalpel with their own hand or fingers during the transfer and scraping?
items.question_zh: 在递刀和刮擦过程中，操作者是否避免解剖刀意外割到或碰到自己的手或手指？
